blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly capable, yet they produce wrong answers indistinguishable from correct ones. In question answering (QA), such an error propagates unnoticed into downstream tasks. Perturbation-based uncertainty quantification (UQ) addresses this by probing a model over a set of input rewrites and reading uncertainty from how much its predictions vary. Yet this set is usually built generically, by free paraphrasing, token-level perturbation, or adversarial search. Such rewrites leave two things uncontrolled that matter in QA: what kind of change is made to the context, and how explicitly the context supports the answer. When neither is controlled, the composition of the set is determined by the generator rather than by design, and the estimate inherits whatever that generator happens to produce. Quality-diversity (QD) search is built to cover a predefined exploration space, so we recast input perturbation as a QD problem and propose \emph{neighborhood elites (NE)}, a neighborhood constructor that spreads answer-preserving rewrites across two axes, the kind of edit and the explicitness of support. We compare NE against three other neighborhood constructors, holding the editor, QA model, uncertainty measure and search objective fixed, and against three scores read from the original context. Across five extractive-QA datasets and five instruction-tuned LLMs, NE improves failure detection against every other constructor in at least 24 of the 25 dataset-model pairs, reaching 0.726 AUROC and 0.211 AUPRC lift over the base rate. Additionally, NE detects failure better than semantic entropy computed over decoder samples, by 0.074 AUROC and 0.062 AUPRC lift, and this advantage widens as the neighborhood grows.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)的能力越来越强,然而它们却产生错误的答案,与正确的答案无法区分. 在回答问题时,这种错误在下游任务中传播。 基于扰动的不确定性量化(UQ)通过在一组输入重写上测试一个模型并读取其预测差异有多大的不确定性来解决这个问题. 然而,这一集通常通过自由抛写、象征性扰动或对抗性搜索来通用地构建。 这种改写留下了两件事,在质评中是无关紧要的:对上下文做了什么样的改变,以及上下文如何明确支持答案. 当两者均不受控制时,集合的构成由生成者决定,而不是由设计,无论生成者碰巧产生什么,估计都会继承. 质量-多样性(QD)搜索是用来覆盖一个预先定义的探索空间的,因此我们把输入扰动重新设定为一个QD问题,并提议\emph{邻里精英 (NE)},一个邻里建筑师,将保存的答案重写在两个轴上,编辑的类型和支持的清晰性. 我们比较NE和另外三个邻里构造者, 持有编辑器,QA模型,不确定度量和搜索目标固定, 在5个采掘-QA数据集和5个经指导调整的LLMs中,NE在25个数据集模型对中至少24个改进了对每个其他构件的故障检测,达到0.726 AUROC和0.211 AUPRC的升力超过基准率。 此外,NE通过0.074 AUROC和0.062 AUPRC升降机检测出比从解码器样本中计算出的语义通量更好的故障,而这一优势随着邻近地区的扩大而扩大。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in natural language understanding and generation ( OpenAI, 2023 ) , question answering and multi-step reasoning ( Wei et al., 2022 ) , and program synthesis ( Chen et al., 2021 ; Li et al., 2023 ) . Beyond single prompts, they increasingly act as the reasoning engine of larger systems, from retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) that grounds answers in external corpora ( Lewis et al., 2020 ; Asai et al., 2023 ) to agentic workflows that plan and call external tools to perform tasks ( Yao et al., 2023 ) . In such pipelines, a single wrong answer can propagate through later steps ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) , so the usefulness of an LLM depends not only on producing an answer, but also on signaling whether that answer can be trusted.
blocks.zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)在自然语言理解和生成(OpenAI, 2023),问答和多步骤推理(Wei等人, 2022),以及程序合成(Chen等人, 2021;Li等人, 2023)方面表现出强大的能力. 除了单一提示之外,它们还日益成为较大系统的推理引擎,从在外部公司(Lewis等人,2020年;Asai等人,2023年)中为答案提供依据的检索增强生成(RAG)到规划和调用外部工具执行任务的代理工作流程(姚等人,2023年). 在这样的管道中,一个单一错误的答案可以通过后期步骤传播(Zhang等人,2024年),因此LLM的有用性不仅取决于生成一个答案,还取决于是否表示该答案可以信任.

blocks.en:
LLMs hallucinate, presenting fabricated facts with the same assurance they provide to correct answers ( Maynez et al., 2020 ; Ji et al., 2022 ) . They tend to agree with the user rather than correct a mistaken assumption ( Sharma et al., 2024 ) , and rarely express doubt or admit when they do not know ( Yin et al., 2023 ) . Asking the model how confident it is, is not helpful, as its stated confidence is poorly aligned with its actual accuracy ( Xiong et al., 2024 ) . This motivates uncertainty quantification (UQ): estimating how much to trust an
answer without relying on the model’s own account of it ( Malinin and Gales, 2021 ; Kuhn et al., 2023 ; Lin et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh:
LLMS幻觉,以它们为正确回答提供的同样保证提出捏造的事实(Maynez等人,2020年;Ji等人,2022年)。 他们倾向于同意用户的意见,而不是纠正错误的假设(Sharma等人,2024年),很少在不知道时表示怀疑或承认(Yin等人,2023年). 询问该模型是否具有信心是没有帮助的,因为其声明的信心与其实际准确性不符(Xiong等人,2024年)。 这推动了不确定性的量化:估计信任程度
在回答时不依赖模型自身的描述(Malinin and Gales,2021;Kuhn等人,2023;Lin等人,2024).

blocks.en: UQ methods can be categorized by the signal used to quantify uncertainty. One family relies on the predictive probabilities assigned by the model ( Malinin and Gales, 2021 ) , while another measures the variability between multiple predictions. The latter requires only model outputs and is therefore applicable in black-box settings. These approaches differ mainly in the way the predictions are produced. Sampling-based methods sample the model several times on a fixed input ( Manakul et al., 2023 ; Farquhar et al., 2024 ) . Perturbation-based methods instead vary the input, rewriting the prompt in ways that should not change the answer ( Gao et al., 2024 ; Song et al., 2025 ) . In either way, the predictions are compared by meaning rather than surface form, which is what semantic entropy measures ( Kuhn et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: UQ方法可以通过用于量化不确定性的信号进行分类. 一个家族依赖于模型指定的预测概率(Malinin and Gales, 2021),而另一个家族则测量多个预测之间的可变性. 后者只要求模型输出,因此适用于黑盒设置. 这些方法主要在预测的产生方式上有所不同. 基于取样的方法在固定输入物上多次取样模型(Manakul等人,2023年;Farquhar等人,2024年)。 基于扰动的方法反而改变了输入,以不应改变答案的方式改写了提示(Gao等人,2024年;Song等人,2025年)。 无论是哪种方式,预测都是通过意义而不是表面形式来比较的,这就是语义式的 en度量(Kuhn等人,2023年).

blocks.en: In the text setting, a perturbation-based estimate is only as informative as the input variants it compares. QD algorithms ( Mouret and Clune, 2015 ; Pugh et al., 2016 ) , coupled with LLMs, can orchestrate the search and assembly of such a set of input variants. The LLM carries out the variations, while quality-diversity steers the search, keeping the best candidate found in each cell it explores, so the set spans many strong candidates rather than a single best one. This pairing has proven useful across domains, generating diverse code ( Lehman et al., 2022 ) , creative writing ( Bradley et al., 2024 ) , and adversarial prompts ( Samvelyan et al., 2024 ) . It is therefore a natural engine for building a set of input variants that vary systematically across a chosen feature space.
blocks.zh: 在文本设置中,基于扰动的估算仅与其比较的输入变体具有同等的信息性. QD算法(Mouret and Clune, 2015;Pugh等人, 2016 )与LLMS结合,可以协调搜索和组装这类输入变体. LLM执行变异,而质量多样性则指导搜索,保留在其探索的每个单元中发现的最佳候选人,因此组合跨越许多强候选人而不是一个最佳候选人. 事实证明,这种配对在各个领域都是有益的,产生了不同的代码(Lehman等人,2022年),创造性的写作(Bradley等人,2024年),以及对抗性的提示(Samvelyan等人,2024年)。 因此,它是建造一套输入变体的自然引擎,这种变体在选定的特征空间中有系统变化。

blocks.en: However, existing perturbation-based UQ builds this set generically, by model-generated paraphrases of the question and inserted tokens ( Gao et al., 2024 ) , or by searching over word substitutions ( Song et al., 2025 ) . A key limitation of these methods is that their rules apply to each rewrite on its own, rather than to the set as a whole. A rewrite is described by the operation applied and by how far it moved from the original, and not by its relation to the answer, though a rephrased question can ask for the same answer more or less directly. The composition of the set is therefore determined largely by the generator, rather than by design.
blocks.zh: 然而,现有的基于扰动的UQ一般地通过模型生成的问题解码词和插入的符号(Gao等人,2024年),或通过搜索词替代物(Song等人,2025年)来构建这组. 这些方法的一个关键限制是,它们的规则适用于每个重写者自己,而不是整个集. 重写是由应用的操作来描述的,以及它与原作的距离有多远,而不是它与答案的关系,尽管重写的问题可以或多或少直接要求相同的答案. 因此,这套装置的组成主要由发电机决定,而不是由设计决定。

blocks.en: In extractive QA, a perturbation set has to control two dimensions: how the context is modified and how explicitly the rewrite still supports the answer. The answer is inside of the rewritten input, so a rewrite changes its support whether or not anything records the change. Two contexts can preserve the same answer while differing substantially in how directly they support it: a rewrite may keep the answer in place but reach its support through a referring expression or spread that support across several sentences. The answer has not changed, but recovering it now places greater demands on the model.
blocks.zh: 在"采掘QA"中,扰动集必须控制两个维度:上下文是如何修改的,以及重写如何明确仍然支持答案. 答案在重写输入的内侧,所以重写会改变其支持,不管是否有东西记录变化. 两种情况既可以保留同一答案,同时又在如何直接支持这一答案方面大相径庭:重写可以保持答案的原位,但通过一个转引表达式或将这种支持分散到若干句子来达到支持。 答案没有改变,但恢复它现在对模型提出了更大的要求.

blocks.en:
To this end, we propose a new perturbation-based UQ method built on a QD search that systematically constructs a variation set across a predefined descriptor space. We refer to this set as the neighborhood of the input. We hypothesize that uncertainty estimated over such structured neighborhoods contains a richer uncertainty signal for detecting model failures than uncertainty derived from less structured variations or repeated sampling of the original input.
Since the context passage already contains the answer, the neighborhood consists of whole-passage rewrites leaving that answer unchanged. The search steers the generator toward specified combinations of edit type and answer support, targeting one cell after another rather than accepting whatever it produces. We show that neighborhoods built this way detect failure better than those from free paraphrasing and two alternative constructors. This advantage also holds over repeated decoder sampling on the original context when using the same uncertainty measure. Our contributions are as follows.
blocks.zh:
为此,我们提出一种基于QD搜索的基于扰动的新的UQ方法,系统地构建一个跨越预先定义的描述空间的变异集. 我们将此集称为输入的邻里。 我们假设,估计的这种结构化街区的不确定性含有一个更丰富的不确定性信号,用于检测模型故障,而不是从结构变化较小或重复取样原始输入所产生的不确定性。
由于上下文段落中已经包含答案,所以邻里由整条通道重写而成,使答案保持不变. 搜索引导生成器向指定的编辑类型和回答支持的组合,针对的是一个又一个单元格,而不是接受它所产生的任何内容. 我们显示,邻里用这种方法 检测故障的比那些 免费抛射和两个替代构造器。 在使用同样的不确定性措施时,这种优势还维持在原始上下文的重复解码器取样上。 我们的贡献如下。

blocks.en:
• Problem formulation. We propose the notion of an input neighborhood for extractive QA and formulate its construction as a coverage problem over a space with two axes: three kinds of edit and four levels of answer support. A rewrite’s coordinates are fixed by deterministic rules rather than by a model
judging its own output. To our knowledge, this is the first perturbation set for UQ built by QD search to cover a space declared in advance. • Method. We introduce neighborhood elites (NE) , an LLM-guided QD search that steers an editor toward the empty cells of a descriptor space spanned by edit type and answer support, and admits a rewrite only when a deterministic check confirms the requested edit was realized. Its rewrites compound along a lineage, each inheriting an already-edited context and applying one further answer-preserving edit, so the neighborhood reaches contexts that no single edit of the original could produce. • Empirical evaluation. We show across five extractive-QA datasets and five instruction-tuned LLMs that NE improves failure detection over every other constructor in at least 24 of the 25 dataset–model pairs, reaching 0.726 AUROC and 0.211 AUPRC lift over the base rate. It exceeds semantic entropy over decoder samples by 0.074 AUROC and 0.062 AUPRC lift, at the same measure, predictions and instances. Its neighborhoods span roughly twice as many kinds of rewrite as the nearest constructor. NE gains 0.100 AUROC as its neighborhood grows from three rewrites to seven while decoder sampling gains 0.030 from the same number of samples.

blocks.en: 2.2 Constructing the neighborhood with targeted MAP-Elites
blocks.zh: 2.2 国家 以目标 MAP-Elites 构建周边环境

blocks.en: We construct the archive 𝒜 x \mathcal{A}_{x} with neighborhood elites (NE), an LLM-guided QD search that separates linguistic variation from archive organization: an editor LLM produces candidate answer-preserving rewrites of x x , and MAP-Elites structures their exploration and decides which are kept. The rest of this section specifies NE.
blocks.zh: 我们用邻里精英(NE)构建存档 A x\ mathcal{A}_{x}, LLM 制导的QD搜索将语言变异与存档组织区分开来: 一个编辑 LLM 生成 xx 的候选保存答案的重写, 以及 MAP-Elites 构建了它们的探索和决定哪些保存. 本节其余部分具体规定了NE.

blocks.en: By design, MAP-Elites maintains many high-performing rewrites rather than converging to a single best one ( Mouret and Clune, 2015 ) . We partition the archive into the cells of 𝒟 \mathcal{D} , each a distinct realized mode of context variation, and every occupied cell keeps its highest-scoring valid rewrite. Coverage is a property of the archive rather than a term in the search objective.
blocks.zh: 在设计上,MAP-Elites保持许多高性能的重写,而不是汇合到一个最佳的单曲(Mouret and Clune, 2015). 我们将归档分割到 D\ mathcal{ D} 的单元格中, 每个单元格都有不同的实现上下文变化模式, 每个被占用的单元格都会保留最高评分的有效重写 。 覆盖是档案的财产,而不是搜索目标中的一个术语.

blocks.en: The editor LLM is the core component that turns a structured edit request into a natural-language rewrite. Given the question q q , the context x x , the fixed answer specification, and an edit program (a request for a particular kind of change), editor LLM returns a rewrite that makes that change while keeping the answer to q q recoverable. Our edit programs follow the tradition of behavioral and robustness testing for NLP, in which meaning-preserving transformations probe a model’s stability ( Ribeiro et al., 2020 ; Gui et al., 2021 ) . Several of these edits mirror standard operations from this line, such as syntax changes, discourse organization, the placement of the answer’s support, and the surrounding context. We provide the prompt templates that instantiate each edit type, together with their strategy variants in Appendix G .
blocks.zh: 编辑器LLM是将结构化的编辑请求变成自然语言重写的核心组件. 鉴于问题 q q,上下文 x x, 固定的答案规格, 和一个编辑程序(请求特定类型的修改), 编辑器 LLM 返回一个重写, 使该修改同时保留对 q q 的答案可恢复 。 我们的编辑程序遵循了NLP行为和强健测试的传统,在NLP中,意义保留转换探究模型的稳定性(Ribeiro等人,2020年;Gui等人,2021年)。 其中一些编辑反映了本行的标准操作,如语法变化,语句组织,解答支持的放置,以及周围上下文. 我们提供即时模板,将每种编辑类型与附录G中的策略变体一起即时化。

blocks.en: The QD search begins by applying edit programs directly to x x and filling the archive with one rewrite at a time, which seeds the initial cells. Each later step either selects an archived rewrite as a parent or targets an empty cell to widen coverage. It then mutates the edit program and asks the editor to apply it. When a parent rewrite is used, the editor edits that parent rather than x x , so edits accumulate over a lineage, and the search reaches rewrites that no single edit of x x could produce. Because empty cells are targeted before occupied ones are refined, the archive first spreads across 𝒟 \mathcal{D} and only then improves the rewrites it already holds.
blocks.zh: QD搜索开始于将编辑程序直接应用到xx上,并一次填充一个重写,以种子初始单元格. 之后的每一个步骤要么选择一个存档重写为父,要么瞄准一个空单元格以扩大覆盖范围. 然后它变异编辑程序,并要求编辑器应用. 当使用父重写时,编辑器会编辑该父而非x x ,因此编辑会累积在一个线程上,搜索会达到X的单个编辑无法产生的重写. 因为空单元格在被占用的单元格被精炼之前就成为目标,所以档案首先会扩散到D\ mathcal{D}之间,然后才能改进它已经持有的重写.

blocks.en: Throughout a lineage, we keep the question q q , gold answer set, and the original context x x fixed for answer preservation, and allow only the current parent to be edited, yielding an offspring. An offspring must therefore be a genuine change to its parent yet still keep the original answer recoverable. This limits semantic drift without preventing multi-step change. Appendix 1 gives the algorithm and Appendix C.6 the scheduling and budget. The constructors we compare against are defined in Section 3 .

blocks.en: Admission to the archive separates the feasibility of a rewrite from its value under the search objective . Every candidate must clear three deterministic gates before it is scored or placed in archive. The rewrite must first pass the deterministic answer-preservation gate (see Appendix C.4.1 ). Failed rewrites are discarded from the search. A second gate checks that the rewrite realizes the requested edit type. This gate is a deterministic, rule-based check, and it is independent of the editor. The requested type is taken from the edit program, and the guard compares the output rewrite against the context from which it is edited (the original x x for seeds, the parent for offspring). The third check rejects a candidate that is identical to a rewrite already in the archive, so each retained rewrite is distinct.
blocks.zh: 输入归档将重写的可行性与搜索目标下的价值区分开来 。 每个候选人都必须清理三个决定性大门,然后才能得分或归档。 重写必须首先通过确定性的回答-保全门(见附录C.4.1)。 从搜索中丢弃失败的重写 。 第二门检查重写实现请求的编辑类型 。 这个门是决定性的,基于规则的检查,它独立于编辑器. 所请求的类型取自编辑程序,守护者将输出重写与编辑时的上下文(原始xx表示种子,父为后代)进行比较. 第三个检查拒绝一个与已经保存在档案中的重写完全相同的候选人,因此每个保留重写是不同的.

blocks.en: Concretely, each edit type has a structural signature the guard verifies: a distractor must keep every reference sentence intact as an ordered subsequence while adding at least one sentence; a reorder must keep the same sentences and change only their order; and a style rewrite must change the wording without reducing to a pure reordering or a pure insertion (exact conditions in Appendix C.4.2 ). A rewrite that fails the rule for its requested edit type is rejected.
blocks.zh: 具体地说,每个编辑类型都有一个结构上的签名,守护者验证:一个分光器必须保持每一个参考句作为命令的子序列完整,同时至少添加一个句子;一个重排必须保持相同的句子,只改变它们的顺序;一个样式重写必须改变措辞,而不减少为纯重排或纯插入(附录C.4.2中的确切条件). 重写其请求的编辑类型规则失败的重写被拒绝 。

blocks.en: Two coordinates then place a surviving rewrite in 𝒟 \mathcal{D} : the requested edit type gives its rewrite-type cell, and the produced text is measured to give its support-explicitness cell. Because a rewrite failing its type check is rejected, the rewrite-type axis records the edit actually applied rather than the one requested.
blocks.zh: 两个坐标然后在 D\ mathcal{D} 中放置一个幸存的重写: 请求的编辑类型给出其重写类型单元格, 生成的文本被测量以给出其支持- explient 单元格 。 由于重写失败其类型检查被拒绝,重写类型轴记录的是实际应用的编辑,而不是请求的编辑.

blocks.en: Placement of a rewrite in the descriptor space does not guarantee survival. Each cell keeps only a single best rewrite, so the rewrites that land in a cell compete for it. The competition is decided by the search objective , a normalized weighted mean of three terms: semantic closeness to x x , surface edit-magnitude from x x , and fluency (Appendix C.5 ). A new rewrite takes an empty cell, or replaces the current occupant only if its search objective value is strictly higher. In MAP-Elites terms, this is the fitness function, which ranks the solutions competing for the same cell. We call this term the search objective throughout. Answer preservation is not one of these terms; it is the hard gate that every scored rewrite has already cleared, so it governs admission but not ranking.
blocks.zh: 在描述空间中放置重写不能保证生存. 每个细胞只保留一个最好的重写,所以重写在细胞中降落的重写者会与之竞争. 比赛由搜索目标决定,一个正常的加权平均值为三个术语:语义接近xx,表面编辑宽度从xxx,流利度(附录C.5). 新的重写取一个空单元格,或者只在其搜索目标值严格较高的情况下替换当前占用者. 在MAP-Elites的术语中,这是健身功能,它为争夺同一个细胞的解决方案排序. 我们称这个词为搜索目标 答案保存不是这些术语之一;这是每个得分重写已经清除的硬门,因此它管理录取但不排位.

blocks.en: 2.3 From neighborhood disagreement to an uncertainty score
blocks.zh: 第2.3条 从邻里分歧到不确定的分数

blocks.en: After search ends, the archive 𝒜 x \mathcal{A}_{x} turns into an uncertainty signal in one step. We query f θ f_{\theta} once on each rewrite x ~ \tilde{x} kept in 𝒜 x \mathcal{A}_{x} , and save its prediction. The uncertainty score reads only the neighborhood. We group the predictions into semantic-equivalence classes and take the dispersion of that class distribution as the per-instance score u ⁡ ( x ) u(x) , so that predictions concentrated in one class indicate confidence and predictions spread across several indicate uncertainty.
blocks.zh: 搜索结束后,归档 A x\ mathcal{A}_{x} 在一步中变成不确定信号 。 我们在每次重写 x ~\ tilde{x} 时询问 f\\\\\\theta} 并保存其预测 。 不确定的分数只读邻里 我们把预测分为语义-等值类,并将该类分布的分散性作为偶数得分u ⁡(x) u(x) ,(x) ,这样,集中在一个类的预测就表明信心,而分布在几个类的预测则表明不确定性。

blocks.en: We use the discrete form of semantic entropy ( Kuhn et al., 2023 ; Farquhar et al., 2024 ) , which takes the class distribution from the proportion of predictions in each class rather than from their likelihoods, so the score separates surface variation from disagreement in meaning without access to model probabilities. Because u u depends only on the multiset of predictions, it sees neither the gold answer nor which constructor built the neighborhood, so any difference in failure detection is attributable to the neighborhood rather than to the measure read from it.
blocks.zh: 我们使用离散形式的语义 en(Kuhn等人,2023年;Farquhar等人,2024年),它从每个类的预测比例中,而不是从其概率中,取出类的分布,因此分数将表面差异与意义上的分歧区分开来,没有获得模型概率. 因为u u 仅依赖于多集预测,它既不看到黄金答案,也不看到哪个建筑者建造了邻里,所以任何故障检测的差异都归因于邻里,而不是从邻里读来的度量.

We use all models for inference only, and inference settings are held fixed across experiments.

blocks.en: 1. Free-form paraphrasing (FP). FP generates independent answer-preserving rewrites directly from the original context x x . We denote the resulting paraphrases by x ~ 1 , x ~ 2 , … , x ~ N \tilde{x}_{1},\tilde{x}_{2},\ldots,\tilde{x}_{N} , giving the generation pattern x → x ~ 1 , x → x ~ 2 , … , x → x ~ N . x\rightarrow\tilde{x}_{1},x\rightarrow\tilde{x}_{2},\ldots,x\rightarrow\tilde{x}_{N}. Each x ~ i \tilde{x}_{i} is produced independently from x x with the same editor LLM, without a descriptor space, parent–offspring lineage, or evolutionary search. This constructor tests whether conventional free-form reformulation alone provides sufficient predictive variation for uncertainty estimation. 2. Untargeted MAP-Elites (U-ME). U-ME adds parent–offspring generation and descriptor cell-based selection, following x → P → O x\rightarrow P\rightarrow O , where x x is the original context, P P is an archived rewrite selected as the parent, and O O is the generated offspring. The parent P P guides the generation of O O , but inheritance is not enforced, so the offspring may only weakly reflect the parent transformation or may ignore P P entirely. Candidate rewrites are validated, assigned to cells, and retained through competition on the search objective. 3. Static bucket sampling (SBS). SBS keeps the archive but removes the search. It issues a fixed budget of independent proposals from the original context x x , cycling the three rewrite types in turn under a single prompt strategy, so the generation pattern is x → x ~ 1 , x → x ~ 2 , … x\rightarrow\tilde{x}_{1},\ x\rightarrow\tilde{x}_{2},\ \ldots with no parent and no lineage. Each candidate clears the same gates as NE, including the realization check, and is then placed in the cell given by its rewrite type and its measured support, where it competes on the search objective exactly as in the two MAP-Elites constructors. Placement is therefore decided after generation rather than aimed at. This constructor isolates the evolutionary component of the proposed constructor: it asks whether the archive and its gates alone recover the coverage that lineage and cell targeting produce.

blocks.en: We additionally report three scores that measures uncertainty from the original context, and never the correctness of its prediction. NLL is the negative log-likelihood of the QA model’s own greedy answer on x x , normalised by answer-token count ( Malinin and Gales, 2021 ) . It is one score per instance. (2023) . Decoder semantic entropy (DSE) applies the same discrete semantic entropy we read from a neighborhood, over the same clustering, to decoder samples of x x rather than to rewrites of it ( Farquhar et al., 2024 ) . For each instance, it draws as many samples as NE’s archive holds rewrites, so against NE the measure, the number of predictions per instance and the instances are all held fixed, and the only difference is whether the variation comes from resampling the decoder or from rewriting the context. Samples are drawn at temperature 0.7 0.7 and top- p p 0.95 0.95 , since greedy decoding on a fixed context returns the same answer every time and an entropy of zero.

We evaluate each uncertainty score by failure detection, measured by AUROC and AUPRC. A reliable score is higher on failures than on correct predictions, so we take an incorrect original-context prediction as the positive class, paired with that instance’s uncertainty score, following
established LLM uncertainty and hallucination-detection evaluations ( Kuhn et al., 2023 ; Farquhar et al., 2024 ; Xiong et al., 2024 ; Manakul et al., 2023 ) . AUROC measures how well the score ranks failures above correct predictions. AUPRC additionally depends on the failure rate, which differs across methods with their scoring pools, so we report it as lift , the AUPRC minus the base rate (the share of instances in the pools whose original-context prediction is incorrect).

blocks.en: 5 Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论和结论

blocks.en: Our results confirm the hypothesis in both of its parts. Uncertainty measured over a structured neighborhood detects failure better than uncertainty from less structured rewrites, and better than uncertainty from decoder sampling of the original context. Neighborhoods that occupy many cells probe the model along several different kinds of rewrite, and each one is a further chance for its prediction to move, so disagreement accumulates. Holding every constructor on the same instances and matching predictions, and raising the number of neighborhood size K K from three to seven, widens the gaps: NE gains 0.100 AUROC across the sweep against 0.047 for FP and 0.030 for decoder sampling (Table 3 ). A neighborhood confined to one kind of rewrite asks the same question repeatedly, which is why FP, at 0.98 cells, detects failure below NLL. Volume does not compensate for narrow coverage, since U-ME keeps more rewrites per instance than NE (5.90 vs. 4.43), covers half as many cells, and scores lower. Against decoder sampling, the comparison is tighter. Resampling needs the decoder made stochastic before it produces any signal, at temperature 0.7, while NE’s disagreement appears under greedy decoding. NE leads it by 0.074 AUROC and 0.062 AUPRC lift, so a model’s own output distribution on a fixed context carries less signal about failure than the neighborhood of NE around that context. The lead narrows on Natural Questions and NewsQA, the two datasets where every constructor covers the least (Appendix B.3 , Figure 5 ).
blocks.zh: 我们的结果证实了其两个部分的假设。 在一个结构化的邻里上测得的不确定性比从结构化程度较低的重写中测得的不确定性更好,比从原始上下文的解码器取样中测得的不确定性更好. 占据许多细胞的邻里沿着几种不同的重写来探测模型,每一种都是其预测移动的又一个机会,因此分歧会累积. 将每个构造器都放在相同的实例和匹配的预测上,并将邻里大小的K K从3个增加到7个,这扩大了差距:在扫荡过程中,NE收益为0.100 AUROC,FP为0.047,解码器取样为0.030(表3)。 一个局限于一种重写的邻居一再提出同样的问题,这就是为什么FP在0.98细胞时检测到NLL以下的故障. 量并不能弥补狭窄的覆盖范围,因为U-ME每个实例的重写量比NE(5.90对4.43)要多,覆盖的单元格数要多一半,得分要低. 对照解码器取样,比较更为严格. NE的分歧似乎在贪婪的解码下出现。 NE领先于0.074 AUROC 和 0.062 AUPRC 升降机,因此一个模型本身在固定上下文上的输出分布比NE周围的失败信号要少。 领先缩小了自然问题和新闻QA,即每个构造器覆盖最少的两个数据集(附录B.3,图5 )。

blocks.en: Resampling the predictions from the QA model reads only what the model does with a single context, which limits what it can reveal. Varying the context draws on a different source of variation, and in our comparison it goes further. Under the same uncertainty measure and sample count, NE detects failure better than over decoder samples. Extracting a richer uncertainty signal from a QD search is mostly a matter of supervising the editor. An editor asked to paraphrase produces one kind of change, so the edit to perform and the cell it should reach have to be stated in the prompt. The rewrite that it returns does not guaranty that the requested edit is applied because the editor repeats itself and does not reliably perform the edit it was asked for. Without a check, 0.17 of retained rewrites are duplicates, and only 0.27 realize the requested type. Neither failure is visible to the search unless a deterministic rule catches it, so these are gates rather than preferences. Without them, the descriptor axis records a request rather than a behavior. Empty cells in the defined descriptor space must also be targeted, since an editor asked for more of the same returns to cells the archive already holds. Detection improves from the 8B editor to the 14B and does not progress beyond that, even as the archives continue to grow, so a larger editor does not result in further gains. Detection keeps improving as the neighborhood grows, so the useful size is determined by the supply of rewrites.
blocks.zh: 重现来自QA模型的预测,只读到该模型在单一上下文下所做的,这限制了它所能揭示的内容. 不同的背景利用了不同的变异来源,而我们进行比较时,它更进一步。 在同样的不确定性度量和样本计数下,NE检测失败比解码器样本更好. 从QD搜索中提取更丰富的不确定性信号,主要是监督编辑的问题. 一个被请求解译的编辑器会产生一种变化,所以要执行的编辑和它应该到达的单元格必须在即时表示. 它返回的重写不会保证所请求的编辑被应用,因为编辑器自己重复,并且不能可靠地执行它所要求的编辑. 没有检查,保留后的0.17重写是重复的,只有0.27实现请求的类型. 除非确定性的规则抓住它,否则搜索工作都看不到失败之处,因此这些是大门而不是偏好。 没有它们,描述轴记录的是请求而不是行为. 定义描述符空间中的空单元格也必须成为目标,因为编辑器要求更多相同的返回到已保存的单元格中. 侦测工作从8B编辑器改进到14B,没有取得更多进展,即使档案继续增加,所以一个更大的编辑器不会带来进一步的收益. 侦测工作随着邻里逐渐增多而不断改进,所以实用的大小由重写器的供应决定.

blocks.en: What distinguishes this work from prior perturbation-based UQ is not that we vary the input, but that we decide in advance what the variation should span. Sampling-based methods vary the decoder and hold the input fixed ( Kuhn et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2023 ) . Rewrite-based methods vary the question or prompt through free paraphrasing ( Elazar et al., 2021 ) , token-level edits with temperature sampling ( Gao et al., 2024 ) , or search over token-level mutations ( Song et al., 2025 ) , but none of them lays out a descriptor space that neighborhoods are required to cover edit types and answer support axes. Therefore, the neighborhood is whatever the generator happened to produce, and FP shows the consequence. Among any three rewrites of the same passage, its edit magnitude is narrow, spanning 0.06 against 0.31 for NE (Appendix B.6 , Figure 7 ), so its probes of a single instance are close to repetitions of one another. QD search has been used to find inputs that break a model ( Samvelyan et al., 2024 ) . We use it to find answer-invariant rewrites instead.
blocks.zh: 这项工作与先前基于扰动的UQ的区别不在于我们改变输入,而在于我们事先决定该变化应该涵盖什么. 采样方法改变解码器,并固定输入(Kuhn等人,2023年;Wang等人,2023年)。 基于重写的方法通过自由抛写(Elazar等人,2021年),带有温度抽样的符号级编辑(Gao等人,2024年),或者在符号级突变之上搜索来改变问题或迅速. (Song et al., 2025),但其中没有任何一个设置一个描述空间,要求邻里覆盖编辑类型并回答支持轴. 因此,邻里是发电机的产物,FP显示了后果。 在同一个段落的任何三个重写中,其编辑量都比较窄,从0.06对0.31对NE(附录B.6,图7),因此其单个实例的探测器接近相互重复. QD搜索被用于寻找打破模型的输入(Samvelyan等人,2024年). 我们用它来寻找答案 - 变化无常的重写。

blocks.en: A few choices set the scope of what these results show. The axes of the descriptor space took shape through earlier experiments, and it is a design choice rather than a global optimality. Twelve cells may not provide enough resolution for exploring the neighborhood space. Both axes are assigned by rule rather than by a person: the edit type by a deterministic structural check and the support level by a heuristic. Although neither rule is validated against human judgment, both are reproducible, keeping the models out of the decision and applied to the text itself, so realized records what a rewrite does rather than what the editor says it did. The four constructors differ in more than one respect each, so we do not attribute the improvement to any single mechanism. NE also runs ten prompt strategies against two for the untargeted search and one each for the other two constructors, a registry that cell targeting entails rather than an advantage beside it. We provide further limitations in Appendix I .
blocks.zh: 一些选择确定了这些结果所显示的范围。 描述空间的轴通过早期的实验而成型,它是一个设计选择,而不是全球优化. 12个细胞可能无法提供足够的分辨率来探索邻里空间. 两轴都由规则而不是一个人来指定:编辑类型通过定型结构检查,支持级别通过heuristic. 虽然这两个规则都无法对人的判断进行验证,但两者都是可复制的,将模型排除在决定之外,并应用于文本本身,所以实现记录了一个重写所做的事情而不是编辑所说的话. 四个构建者在每一个方面都不同,因此我们不把改进归因于任何单一机制。 NE还针对两个非目标搜索和另外两个构建者各实施10个快速战略,一个是细胞目标设定包含的登记册,而不是它旁边的优势。 我们在附录一中提供了进一步的限制。

blocks.en: A prerequisite for reliable QA models is knowing when their answers should be trusted, and post-hoc uncertainty estimation for LLMs comprises several families of methods that differ in what they inspect to estimate it: the probabilities a model assigns to its answer, the confidence it expresses in words, its own judgment of whether output is correct, and the agreement among its repeated outputs. The most direct method assesses confidence from the model’s own output probabilities in the form of token-level likelihood, length-normalized sequence likelihood, or sequence predictive entropy ( Ott et al., 2018 ; Jiang et al., 2021 ; Malinin and Gales, 2021 ) . However, free-form answers expose a difficult problem. As the same answer can be expressed in many surface forms, token-level probability conflates linguistic variation with genuine uncertainty about the answer. A second studies confidence in words, prompting the model to state how sure it is, as an explicit numerical probability or a qualitative expression of certainty ( Lin et al., 2022 ; Tian et al., 2023 ; Xiong et al., 2024 ) . A third has the model judge its own answers, estimating the probability that a proposed answer is correct Kadavath et al. (2022) . A fourth derives uncertainty from consistency across multiple samples . Self-consistency aggregates agreement over sampled model outputs ( Wang et al., 2023 ) , SelfCheckGPT identifies hallucinations by checking whether resampled responses corroborate one another ( Manakul et al., 2023 ) , and semantic entropy clusters sampled answers into semantic equivalence classes under bidirectional entailment and taking the entropy over those classes ( Kuhn et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 可靠的质量保证模型的一个先决条件是知道何时应该相信它们的答案,而LLMs的hoc后不确定性估计包括几个不同方法的家族,它们为估计它而检查的方法是:一个模型给它的答案分配的概率,它用文字表达的信心,它自己对产出是否正确的判断,以及它重复的产出之间的一致. 最直接的方法从模型本身的输出概率中以符号级概率,长度常态化序列概率,或序列预测 en(Ott等人,2018年;Jiang等人,2021年;Malinin and Gales,2021年)的形式来评估信心. 然而,自由形式的答案暴露出一个困难的问题. 由于同样的答案可以用许多表层形式表示,象征级概率将语言变异与答案的真正不确定性相融合. 第二次研究对文字的信心,促使模型说明其是否确定,作为明确的数值概率或确定性的质量表达(Lin等人,2022年;Tian等人,2023年;Xiong等人,2024年)。 第三个有模型判断自己的答案,估计一个拟议答案正确Kadavath等人(2022年)的概率. 第四个来源于多个样本的一致性。 SelfCheckGPT通过检查重印反应是否相互印证来识别幻觉(Manakul等人,2023年),以及语义 en类群在双向结合下将答案取样成语义等同类,并将等同于这些类(Kuhn等人,2023年)。

blocks.en: A separate line of work quantifies uncertainty by perturbing the input rather than the output, taking a prediction’s stability under perturbation as a confidence signal. SPUQ perturbs the prompt and aggregates the resulting answers into a confidence score ( Gao et al., 2024 ) , while input clarification ensembling generates disambiguated variants of an ambiguous input and ensembles predictions across them ( Hou et al., 2024 ) . More recent methods enrich this family: Inv-Entropy studies uncertainty probabilistically, deriving it from the diversity of inputs consistent with a given output and using a genetic algorithm to diversify the perturbations ( Song et al., 2025 ) , while paraphrase-based decomposition separates prompt-driven from sampling uncertainty by aggregating predictions over semantically equivalent rewordings ( Cox et al., 2025 ) . These methods share the intuition behind the proposed approach. Self-disagreement across variants of a query signals uncertainty. This premise is well founded, since pretrained models are known to answer inconsistently across meaning-preserving paraphrases ( Elazar et al., 2021 ) . Nevertheless, they leave two components uncontrolled. First, the rewrites form an unstructured, ad-hoc set with no guarantee of covering distinct kinds of change. Second, they need not preserve the answer, so disagreement can reflect a changed answer rather than genuine uncertainty. Without an explicit construction-time guarantee, answer preservation can be verified only post hoc (e.g., by an LLM judge ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) ) rather than enforced by design.
blocks.zh: 单独的一行工作通过扰动输入而不是输出来量化不确定性,以扰动下的预测稳定性作为置信信号. SPUQ将迅速的解答和结果的解答汇总为置信分数(Gao等人,2024年),而输入澄清共振则产生模糊的输入的变体和相互间的共振预测(Hou等人,2024年). 最近的方法丰富了这个家庭: Inv-Entropy研究不确定性的概率,从与特定产出一致的投入的多样性中推导出来,并使用基因算法使扰动多样化(Song等人,2025年),而以语句为基础的分解则通过将预测汇总于模拟等效重写(Cox等人,2025年),将迅速驱动的分解与取样不确定性分开。 这些方法与拟议方法的直觉相同。 查询信号不确定性的变体之间的自我分歧. 这个前提是有根据的,因为据了解,预先训练过的模型对保留含义的短语的回答不一致(Elazar等人,2021年)。 然而,它们使两个组成部分不受控制。 首先,重写形成一个无结构化的特设集,不能保证涵盖各种不同的变化。 第二,它们不需要保留答案,因此分歧可以反映一个变化的答案,而不是真正的不确定性。 没有明确的施工时间保证,答案保全只能由事后(如LLM法官(郑等人,2023年))进行验证,而不是通过设计强制执行.

blocks.en: Beyond uncertainty estimation, input perturbation is the basis of behavioral and robustness testing, which probes a model by perturbing its inputs and checking whether predictions stay consistent ( Dong et al., 2023 ) . CheckList casts this as invariance testing: label-preserving perturbations are applied to an input, and the prediction is expected to remain unchanged ( Ribeiro et al., 2020 ) . Relatedly, semantically equivalent adversarial rules identify meaning-preserving rewrites that flip a model’s prediction ( Ribeiro et al., 2018 ) . For reading comprehension specifically, TextFlint provides task-level transforms such as inserting distractor sentences and shifting the answer’s position ( Gui et al., 2021 ) , and adversarially inserted distractors are a classic stress test of QA models ( Jia and Liang, 2017 ) , and syntactically controlled paraphrasing rewrites an input while varying its syntax ( Iyyer et al., 2018 ) . These suites are built to measure robustness: they combine answer-preserving and answer-breaking edits such as minimal contrastive edits that flip the gold answer ( Gardner et al., 2020 ) and report how far accuracy falls. Our context edits are drawn from this vocabulary, and we claim none of the edit types as new. What differs is their use: we retain only the answer-preserving edits and repurpose them not as a robustness benchmark but as a probe for post-hoc uncertainty, where disagreement among predictions, rather than a drop in accuracy, is the quantity of interest.
blocks.zh: 除了不确定性估计外,输入扰动是行为和稳健性测试的基础,它通过扰动其输入和检查预测是否一致来探测一个模型(Dong等人,2023年). CheckList将这一点视为变化性测试:将保留标签扰动应用于输入,预计预测不会改变(Ribeiro等人,2020年)。 与此相关的是,模拟等同的对抗规则确定了推翻模型预测(Ribeiro等人,2018年)的保留含义重写。 对于阅读理解而言,TextFlint提供了任务级的转换,如插入分散语句和转移答案位置(Gui等人,2021年),对抗性插入分散语是QA模型(Jia和Liang,2017年)的经典应力测试,而综合控制抛写重写一个输入,同时改变其语法(Iyyer等人,2018年). 这些套房的建造是为了测量稳健性:它们结合了保存答案和破解答案的编辑,如微小的对比编辑,翻转黄金答案(Gardner等人,2020年),并报告准确度下降多远. 我们的上下文编辑来自这个词汇,我们声称没有一个编辑类型是新的. 不同之处在于它们的用途:我们只保留了保存答案的编辑,并重新将其用作不是强健性的基准,而是对后热不确定性的探测,预测中的分歧,而不是精确度的下降,是兴趣的数量。

blocks.en: QD algorithms search for a set of solutions that are individually high-performing yet collectively diverse ( Pugh et al., 2016 ) . One type of QD algorithm is MAP-Elites, which partitions a space of behavioral-descriptor cells over the search space and keeps the single best solution found in each. The search result is an archive of the best solutions that spans the space rather than a single optimum ( Mouret and Clune, 2015 ) . Driving this search requires a variation operator that turns existing solutions into new candidates, and LLMs have proven effective in that role as mutation operators that rewrite a candidate ( Lehman et al., 2022 ) , and as crossover operators that recombine candidates ( Meyerson et al., 2024 ) . Paired this way, QD has produced broad, systematically diverse collections of model outputs: diverse adversarial prompts for red-teaming ( Samvelyan et al., 2024 ) , open-ended creative text guided by model-based feedback ( Bradley et al., 2024 ) , and coverage of the prompt space itself ( Santos et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: QD算法搜索一组单个性能高但集体多样的解决方案(Pugh等人,2016年). QD算法的一种类型是MAP-Elites,它将一个行为描述细胞的空间分割到搜索空间上,并保留每个空间中找到的单个最佳解决方案. 搜索结果是一个跨越空间的最佳解决方案的档案,而不是单一的最佳解决方案(Mouret和Clune,2015年)。 推动这一搜索需要一位变异操作员,将现有解决方案转化为新的候选者,而LLMs已证明在这种作用上是有效的,因为变异操作员重写了候选者(Lehman等人,2022年),以及交叉操作员重压缩候选者(Meyerson等人,2024年)。 QD以这种方式产生了广泛、系统多样的模型产出集:各种对抗性红色队伍动员(Samvelyan等人,2024年),以模型反馈为指导的开放式创意文本(Bradley等人,2024年),以及快速空间本身的覆盖(Santos等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: Constructors differ in how many valid rewrites they yield, and runs can differ in prediction availability. We therefore build a strict matched evaluation set separately for each dataset, QA model, and neighborhood size K K . An example enters the set only if it satisfies all of: 1. Shared instance. The same test instance has a neighborhood built by every constructor and answered by the QA model. 2. Identical original prediction. The original-context prediction agrees across runs after standard answer normalization. 3. Identical failure label. The failure label (the original-context prediction is incorrect) is present and identical for all constructors. 4. Sufficient supply. Every constructor provides at least K K valid answer-preserving rewrites for the example. For every eligible test instance, we then draw exactly K K predictions from each constructor, so all constructors are compared on the identical set of examples with an equal number of inputs per example. We sweep K ∈ { 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 } K\in\{3,4,5,6,7\} , building a separate matched set per K K ; eligibility tightens as K K grows, so the set shrinks with K K , but within a given ( K K , dataset – model ) it is identical across constructors.

blocks.en: The spread reported in Figure 7 is computed over all retained rewrites pooled together, so it confounds two sources of variation. The first is variation within a neighborhood, among the rewrites of a single context. The second is variation between neighborhoods: the level at which each context’s rewrites sit, set by the passage as much as by the constructor. Only the first is available to an uncertainty estimate, since that estimate is computed from the rewrites of one context. We therefore decompose the pooled variance into a within- neighborhood and a between-neighborhood term.

blocks.en: Intuitively, the search is goal-directed. It bootstraps by editing the original context x x under each applicable strategy, and from that point on, it repeats a target-mutate-validate loop. It picks a descriptor cell to fill, mutates the best matching rewrite toward that cell under the hard x → P → O x\!\rightarrow\!P\!\rightarrow\!O contract (the original x x stays the validity reference), and admits the result only if it truly realizes the requested edit type. Because acceptance verifies the type, requested and realized types coincide, so every occupied cell holds a rewrite that genuinely is what its coordinates indicate, thus the archive’s rewrite-type axis is a faithful behavior label.

Given the question, the edited context, and the gold answer, the cell is

1. Extract question anchors. We tokenize the question

The rule fixes on primary support sentence where the answer is grounded. The selection prefers in order: the sentence the edit flagged as its support location (if one is recorded), otherwise the first sentence containing the answer. 3. Select the support window. This step decides how much context
counts as the support. When the answer sentence leans on a

blocks.en: The editor in our study serves as a variation operator that turns one context into a new one. Keeping this separate from the archive machinery is important. The editor provides linguistic variation, while the descriptor space and search (Appendices C.2 and and C.6 ) decide where a candidate lands and whether it is kept, resulting in an archive. The editor is a fixed local LLM, queried once per candidate. We provide its identity and generation settings (temperature, token limit, decoding) in the configuration table and we keep these parameters fixed across all datasets and QA models.

blocks.en: We describe the editor and its role in this study in three parts. The interface describes the input query components that editor receives, the question, its gold answer, and the context to rewrite, and the outputs it generates. The edit program drives the query with a requested rewrite type paired with a prompt strategy, an edit program the search evolves. The deterministic gates (Appendix C.4 ) then screen every output, checking whether that answer is preserved and the requested edit is realized before it may enter the archive. All in all, the editor mutates a context under a typed instruction, and only rewrites that keep the answer and realize the edit survive. Below, we describe these steps in depth.

blocks.en: We query the editor with an edit program , which is a requested rewrite type ( operation_type ∈ 𝒯 \in\mathcal{T} ) paired with a prompt strategy . The two levels play different roles. The rewrite type names the behavior we want such as a distractor, a reorder, or a style rewrite. Once realized, it becomes the candidate’s 𝒯 \mathcal{T} coordinate in descriptor space (Appendix C.2.1 ).
blocks.zh: 我们用一个编辑程序来查询编辑器,这个程序是一个请求重写类型(操作__ t\in\ mathcal{T}),与一个快速策略对齐. 这两个层面的作用不同。 重写类型命名我们想要的行为,例如分散注意力,重排顺序,或风格重写. 一旦实现,它就会成为候选人在描述空间中的T\ mathcal{T}坐标(附录C.2.1 ).

blocks.en: However, a bare rewrite type the lacks the refinement necessary to guide a general-purpose editor. An instruction as broad as ”rewrite this in a different style” admits countless outputs and gives the search no way to aim for a particular kind of rewrite. Therefore, we provide concrete guidance to fill in the missing specificity for realizing the rewrite type with prompt strategies.
blocks.zh: 然而,光线重写型号缺乏指导通用编辑器的必要改进。 广泛到“以不同的方式改写”的指令接纳了无数产出,而且无法搜索某一特定类型的改写。 因此,我们提供具体指导,以补足缺失的特异性,实现迅速战略重写类型。

blocks.en: For a style_rewrite , for instance, support_direct_consolidation prompt strategy asks the editor to pull the answer’s support into a single clause, whereas multi_sentence_factored asks it to spread that support across several sentences. Both are style rewrites, yet they push the output toward different support-explicitness cells . An edit program is thus a (type, strategy) pair: ( style_rewrite , multi_sentence_factored ) or ( distractor , distractor_question_overlap ). This structure indicates both the target behavior and the tactic used to realize it. We provide the full set of strategies and their rewrite types in Table 37 .
blocks.zh: 对于样式_ 重写, 例如, 支持_ direct_ construction 即时策略要求编辑器将答案的支持拉入一个单一的条款, 而多句_ 判决_ 因素则要求它将支持分散到多个句子中 。 两者都是风格重写,但都会将输出推向不同的支持-解释性单元格。 因此,编辑程序是一对(类型,策略):(样式_重写,多位_判词_构件)或(分心器,分心器_问题_重叠). 这种结构既表示目标行为,也表示用于实现的战术. 我们在表37中提供了一整套战略及其改写类型。

blocks.en: This two-level design is what lets an LLM act as a controllable variation operator. The type fixes the axis of behavior; the strategy aims within it. The style strategies bias the output toward different support-explicitness cells: two candidates from different strategies that land in the cell compete there. The strategy is therefore a means, not a coordinate: it is how a candidate is steered , not how it is filed . Many strategies map to one rewrite type, and two candidates from different strategies that land in the same cell simply compete there (Appendix C.2.3 ).
blocks.zh: 这种双层设计使得LLM起到可控变异操作员的作用. 该类型修补行为轴;策略目标在于它内部. 风格策略将输出偏重于不同的支持-解释性细胞:来自不同策略的两位候选人登陆细胞内竞争. 因此,该战略是一种手段,而不是一种协调:这是如何指导候选人,而不是如何提出。 许多策略映射到一个重写类型,来自不同策略的两名候选人登陆同一个细胞只是在那里竞争(Appendix C.2.3.).

blocks.en: We admit a candidate rewrite into the archive only after it passes deterministic checks that consult neither the QA model f θ f_{\theta} nor the editor. The rewrite must be non-empty, must differ from the original x x (and, for offspring, from the parent P P ), and must not duplicate a rewrite already in the archive. Two substantive gates then decide admissibility: answer preservation and edit-type realization . Together they form the StrictValid operator used by the NE and the FP (Appendix C.1 ). The U-ME uses the lighter Valid operator, which applies answer preservation but omits the realization guard.

blocks.en: C.5 Search Objective
blocks.zh: C.5 搜索目标

blocks.en: The search objective value is the scalar fitness MAP-Elites uses to select a cell’s best rewrite. Because MAP-Elites keeps only one rewrite per occupied cell, it needs a scalar to decide, among several valid rewrites that fall in the same descriptor cell of 𝒟 \mathcal{D} , which one to keep (Appendix C.2.3 ). The value of the search objective is that scalar ranks only candidates that have already cleared the gates (Appendix C.4 ). It never decides admissibility, and it plays no part in the uncertainty assessment. Because validity is already guaranteed by the deterministic gate, the value is free to express a preference among the valid candidates competing for a cell. In our study, we favor rewrites that vary the surface form while remaining fluent and close to the original meaning.
blocks.zh: 搜索目标值是 Scalar 健身 MAP- Elites 用于选择细胞的最佳重写 。 因为MAP-Elites每个占用的单元格只保留一个重写,所以在D\mathcal{D}的同一刻写单元格中,需要用一个缩写来决定哪个要保留(Appendix C.2.3. 搜索目标的价值在于,scalar只排已经清理过闸门的候选人(附录C.4 . 它从来不决定可否受理,也不参与不确定性评估。 由于确定性门已经保证了有效性,因此该值可以自由地在竞争一个单元格的有效候选人中表达一种偏好。 在我们的研究中,我们倾向于重写,在改变表面形态的同时保持流畅和接近原意.

blocks.en: We keep this heuristic intentionally free of any language-model judge, for two reasons. First, computational cost: MAP-Elites scores every candidate it generates, so a judge would add a model inference call to each of the many search iterations per example, limiting the feasibility at the scale at which we build archives. Second, determinism and reproducibility: a deterministic score makes each archive exactly reproducible, whereas a judge would inject stochasticity, version drift, and prompt sensitivity into the experimental flow, for no stronger validity guarantee than the deterministic gate already provides. Our choice is also standard QD practice: classic MAP-Elites uses a cheap, deterministic scalar fitness, so we follow the mainstream QD design rather than deviating from it.
blocks.zh: 出于两个原因,我们故意不让任何语言模范法官参与这种高压主义。 首先,计算成本: MAP-Elites 给每个候选人评分,所以一个法官会给每个例子的众多搜索迭代中的每一个添加一个模型推论调,限制我们建立档案的规模的可行性. 第二,决定论和再生产:决定论分数使每个档案完全可以再生产,而法官则会向实验流注入色谱、版本漂移和迅速的敏感性,因为没有比决定论门已经提供的更强大的有效性保障。 我们的选择也是标准的QD实践:经典的MAP-Elites使用廉价的,决定性的scalar健身,因此我们遵循主流的QD设计而不是偏离.

blocks.en: C.6 Search and Scheduler
blocks.zh: C.6 搜索和调度器

blocks.en: The search is the per-example procedure that spends a fixed evaluation budget B B to populate and then improve the archive A x A_{x} . Each evaluation is one editor call: we form a single edit program, generate one context, and pass it through the gates, descriptor assignment, and competition described above. The budget counts attempts rather than successes. Rejected, discarded, and accepted candidates each consume one unit so a harder instance yields a sparser archive within the same budget rather than more calls. NE, U-ME and SBS each spend 25 25 evaluations per example whereas FP consumes up to 50 50 attempts. All four reuse the same editor (Appendix C.3 ) and the same gates (Appendix C.4 ). They differ only in how the next edit program is chosen and how an accepted context is stored. Table 36 compares the four construction methods.
blocks.zh: 搜索是每个实例的程序,将固定评价预算B B 用于填充,然后改进归档 A x A_{x}。 每个评价是一个编辑调用:我们组成一个单一的编辑程序,产生一个上下文,并通过上面描述的大门,描述式分配和竞争. 预算是尝试而不是成功。 被拒绝、被抛弃和被接受的候选人每人消耗一个单位,因此,一个更难的例子导致同一预算的档案数量较少,而不是更多的电话。 NE、U-ME和SBS每例花费25项评价,而FP花费多达50项尝试。 所有四个重用相同的编辑器(附录C.3)和相同的门(附录C.4. 它们仅在选择下一个编辑程序和如何存储一个可接受的上下文方面有所不同. 表36比较了四种建筑方法。

blocks.en: C.6.1 One Evaluation
blocks.zh: C.6.1 一个评价

blocks.en: Given an edit program, every evaluation proceeds the same way. The editor produces one context (Appendix C.3 ); the deterministic gates accept or reject it (Appendix C.4 ); and an accepted context is stored. The three archive-based constructors store it by placement : the context is assigned to its cell from its measured descriptor (Appendix C.2 ) and competes for that cell by search objective score (Appendix C.5 ), filling the cell if empty or replacing the occupant only if its score is strictly higher. FP has no grid and instead appends the accepted context to a flat list. Insertion is sequential in every case. The archive (or list) is updated after each evaluation.
blocks.zh: 鉴于一个编辑程序,每个评价都以同样的方式进行。 编辑器产生一种上下文(Appendix C.3);定型门接受或拒绝(Appendix C.4);并存储一个被接受的上下文. 三个基于归档的构造器通过放置来存储它 : 上下文从测量的描述器(Appendix C.2)中分配到它的单元格,并且通过搜索目标分数(Appendix C.5)来竞争该单元格,如果是空的则填充单元格,或者只有在占用器的分数严格较高时才替换该单元格. FP没有网格,而是将接受的上下文附加到一个平面列表中. 在每个情况中,插入是顺序的。 存档(或列表)在每次评价后都会更新.

blocks.en: C.6.2 Targeted Staged Scheduler (NE)
blocks.zh: C.6.2 目标阶段调度器(NE)

blocks.en: NE spends its budget in three stages, bootstrap , coverage , then fitness . Each stage has a distinct objective. Bootstrap and coverage together may use up to B − r B-r evaluations, where B B is the per-example budget and r r is a reserve budget held for the fitness-improvement stage (here B = 25 B=25 and r = 5 r=5 , so at most 20 20 evaluations precede the reserve). The reserve is protected capacity, not a fixed count. If coverage stops early the fitness stage inherits the unused evaluations, and if no action is possible even the reserve may go unspent.
blocks.zh: NE用预算分三个阶段, 每个阶段都有明确的目标。 诱饵和覆盖可一起使用最高B-r B-r的评价,其中BB是每个实例的预算,r是健身改进阶段的储备预算(此处B=25 B=25,r=5 r=5,因此在储备之前最多20项评价)。 储备是保护能力,而不是固定的计数。 如果覆盖率提前停止,健身阶段继承了未使用的评价,如果无法采取行动,连准备金都可能未动用。

blocks.en: We seed the archive with one attempt per strategy. For each (rewrite type, strategy) pair, taken in a fixed order, we generate a single candidate directly from the original context x x with no parent. This populates initial cells cheaply and gives the later stages candidate rewrites to mutate. With the ten strategies of Appendix C.3 , bootstrap issues up to ten attempts.
blocks.zh: 我们用每个策略的一次尝试来引导档案。 对于每对(重写类型,策略),按固定顺序拍摄,我们直接从原来的上下文 x x 产生一个单一的候选者,没有父母. 这可以廉价地填充初始细胞,让后期候选细胞重写突变. 根据附录C.3的十项战略,靴子问题多达十次尝试。

blocks.en:
The coverage stage spends the pre-reserve budget filling empty
cells. Each iteration chooses a target cell, a parent, and a strategy: • Target. We consider only empty cells still worth trying, which we call actionable . A cell qualifies if it has been attempted fewer than twice, at least one strategy can target it, and the archive holds at least one rewrite eligible as its parent. Among the actionable cells we pick the one attempted the fewest times so far, breaking ties by a seeded random draw. • Parent. We rank rewrites by decreasing search objective score and take the first eligible one. For distractor and reorder the parent must already occupy the target support cell, since these edits inherit their parent’s support coordinate (Appendix C.2.2 ). For style_rewrite any elite may serve and the strategy itself aims at the cell. • Strategy. Among strategies compatible with the target cell, we take the globally least-attempted, skipping any that has no eligible parent. Coverage ends when no empty cell is actionable, when a patience of five consecutive attempts fails to occupy a new cell, or when the budget reaches the fitness-reserve boundary.

覆盖阶段将保留地前预算填空
细胞。 每个迭代会选择一个目标细胞,一个父细胞,以及一个策略: • 目标. 我们认为只有空牢房仍然值得尝试, 如果尝试的单元格少于两次,则至少可以有一个策略瞄准它,并且归档中至少包含一个有资格重写为父的单元格。 在可操作的细胞中,我们挑选的细胞 尝试了迄今为止最少的一次, 用种子随机抽取来断开联系。 • 父母。 我们通过降低搜索目标分数来重新排序,并取下第一个合格分数. 对于分心器和重排命令,父程序必须已经占据目标支持单元格,因为这些编辑器继承了母程序的支持坐标(Appendix C.2.2 ). 对于样式_重写任何精英可能服务,策略本身针对细胞. • 战略。 在与目标细胞兼容的策略中,我们采取全球最不尝试,跳过任何没有合格父母的策略. 当无法使用空格时,当连续五次尝试的耐心未能占据新格时,或者当预算到达健身保留区边界时,覆盖就会结束。

blocks.en:
The fitness-improvement stage spends the reserve improving occupied cells, weakest first. We order the current archived rewrites by increasing search objective score and cycle through them. For each, we propose a new candidate for that rewrite’s cell using the least-attempted compatible strategy, and it replaces the occupant only if its search objective value is strictly greater (Appendix C.5 ). Because a candidate is placed by its own measured descriptor, an improvement attempt may land in a different cell than intended. Targeting is therefore best-effort, and final placement always follows
the realized descriptor. The stage ends when the budget is exhausted or no cell admits a further attempt.

已实现的描述符。 当预算耗尽或没有单元承认进一步尝试时,阶段结束.

The split among the three stages is emergent, not configured. On one SQuAD instance the 25 25 evaluations divided into 10 10 bootstrap, 4 4 coverage,
and 11 11 fitness improvement, filling 6 6 of the 12 12 cells: all ten strategies were eligible at bootstrap, coverage halted after four attempts once no empty cell remained actionable, and the remaining eleven evaluations fell to the fitness stage.

blocks.en: C.6.3 Generational Search (U-ME)
blocks.zh: C.6.3 世代搜索(U-ME)

blocks.en: U-ME spends the same 25 25 -evaluation budget as an untargeted, generational loop. It never aims at a particular cell, and a candidate’s cell is known only after it is generated and measured. It begins by generating five seeds directly from x x with no parent, cycling through the three rewrite types (distractor, reorder, style rewrite, then distractor and reorder again) under the fixed prompt variant support_rewrite_aggressive . It then repeats a generational step until the budget is spent. As in NE, we rank the current rewrites by decreasing search objective score, take up to the top five, and generate exactly one offspring from each. Each offspring’s edit program is a deterministic mutation of its parent’s. The requested rewrite type is changed to a different type, and the prompt variant is toggled between the constructors’s two variants ( support_rewrite_aggressive and local_conservative ). In this case, the mutation is a function of the attempt index rather than a random draw. Offspring are validated, placed, and compete exactly as in Appendix C.6.1 , except that this constructor applies the lighter validity gate: it requires answer preservation without the realization guard (Appendix C.4 ) and files each rewrite by its requested type. The loop stops when the budget is exhausted or when no elite is available to serve as a parent.
blocks.zh: U-ME花费同样的25 - 25 - 评价预算作为非目标,世代循环. 它从不针对某个特定细胞,而候选人的细胞只有在生成和测量后才知道。 它首先在固定的即时变种支持_重写_侵犯性下,直接从xx产生5个种子,循环通过三种重写类型(分散,重排,样式重排,再重排). 然后重复代代相传的一步,直到预算用完。 和NE一样,我们通过降低搜索目标分数来排列当前重写,取至前5名,并从每个中产生一个精确的后代. 每个后代的编辑程序是父母的决定性突变。 所请求的重写类型被更改为不同的类型, 快速变体在构造器的两个变体( 支持_ 重写_ 侵犯性 和 local_ conservative ) 之间切换 。 在这种情况下,突变是尝试指数的一个函数,而不是随机图. Offspring被验证,放置,并和附录C.6.1中完全一样竞争,只是这个构造器应用了较轻的有效性门:它需要没有实现守护符(Appendix C.4)的答案保存,并且每个文件都按其请求的类型重写. 当预算用尽或没有精英担任家长时,循环就会停止。

blocks.en: C.6.4 Append Loop (FP)
blocks.zh: C.6.4 附录循环(FP)

blocks.en:
FP has no archive, no parent and no cell targeting. It draws independent paraphrases of the original context x x and appends the valid ones until it matches the size of the main method’s archive. For each test instance, we set the target count K K to the number of accepted elites in that example’s NE archive, so the constructor is compared at the same neighborhood size. We then attempt up to 50 50 proposals, each a single fixed edit program, a style_rewrite under the llm_paraphrase prompt generated from x x with no parent. Each proposal passes through the same gates as the paraphrase-realizing main-method candidates (Appendix C.4 ) and is additionally rejected if it duplicates an
already-accepted paraphrase (exact match after Unicode NFKC and whitespace normalization). Accepted paraphrases are appended in acceptance order; unlike the archive-based constructors there is no cell, no competition and no replacement. The search objective is recorded but never used to admit or rank (Appendix C.5 ). The loop stops at K K accepted paraphrases or 50 50 attempts, whichever comes first. We allow more attempts here than the 25 25 of the MAP-Elites constructors because FP reaches K K less reliably; the larger attempt budget strengthens the FP, making the matched- K K comparison conservative.

blocks.en: We group the predictions by meaning in two stages, where the second stage only merges the classes the first stage forms and never splits them. We first collapse identical predictions into exact-answer classes under a fixed normalization, then merge classes that carry the same meaning with a frozen NLI model ( DeBERTa-v3-base-mnli-fever-anli ), following the semantic entropy construction of Kuhn et al. (2023) . For two exact classes, we render one representative of each as the question-conditioned statement ” The answer to " q q " is a a . ” and classify the pair in both directions. The two classes are equivalent when the model’s top label is entailment each way. In addition, the semantic classes are the connected components of this relation, so a chain of equivalent pairs joins a single cluster. For example, if a neighborhood yields the predictions Uruguay , uruguay. , the Uruguay national team , and Argentina , normalization already places Uruguay and uruguay. in one exact class; the model then judges the Uruguay national team equivalent and merges it in, while Argentina stays apart, so the four raw strings collapse to two answer meanings. The model sees only the question and the predictions; it never sees the gold answer y y or the failure label, and no context is included. The normalization behind the exact classes strips any answer: -style prefix and keeps the first line, applies Unicode nfkc and maps common Unicode punctuation to ASCII, lower-cases, deletes punctuation, drops the articles a , an , and the , collapses whitespace, and rewrites a pure number-word answer (for example twenty-one ) as digits; it applies no stemming and no accent folding.
blocks.zh: 我们按意义将预测分为两个阶段,第二阶段只将第一级各类合并,从不分割. 我们首先在固定的常态下将相同的预测崩溃成精确的回答类,然后将具有相同意义的类与冷冻的NLI模型(DeBERTa-v3-base-mnli-fever-anli)合并,在Kuhn等人(2023年)的语义 en构造之后. 对于两个确切的类别,我们让每个类别中有一个代表作为问题有条件的发言:“对 " q q " 的回答是一个.”并按双向分类。 当模型的顶级标签以各种方式出现时,这两个类别是等同的。 此外,语义类是这种关系的连接部分,因此一连串的等效对子加入一个单组. 乌拉圭、乌拉圭国家队、阿根廷等地都已经实现乌拉圭和乌鲁盖正常化。 在一个准确的类别中;模型然后评选乌拉圭国家队等同,将其合并,而阿根廷则保持分开,因此四个原始字符串崩溃为两个答案含义. 模型只看到问题和预测;它从未看到黄金答案y或失败标签,也没有包含上下文. 精确类后面的常态将任意的答案脱除: - 样式前缀并保留第一行, 对 ASCII 应用 Unicode nfkc 并绘制常见的 Unicode punctuation, 小写, 删除 punctuation, 放下文章 a, a, 和 , 折叠白空格, 将纯数字字的答案( 例如 21) 重写为数字; 它不应用终止和重音折叠 。

blocks.en:
We score each constructor by how well its neighborhood-derived uncertainty separates
correct from incorrect original-context predictions. The prediction we flag is f θ f_{\theta} ’s answer on the original context x x , and we judge its correctness with a
permissive match against the instance’s answer specification: the answer counts as correct
if it matches any accepted gold group—alternative gold answers are singleton groups, so
matching any one suffices—through a cascade of increasingly permissive checks: an exact
match; a normalized match (the normalization of Appendix D ,
extended with month-name date canonicalization); a conservative containment test, in which
a short gold string that appears verbatim inside the normalized prediction counts as a
match; and, last, a bidirectional-entailment test using the same NLI model as the semantic
clustering (Appendix D ). The failure label is the negation of
this correctness, and the cascade is permissive in the direction that matters: a paraphrase
of the gold answer is scored correct rather than counted as a failure, so surface variation
does not inflate the failure set.

We compute AUROC and AUPRC within each of the 25 dataset–model pairs and report the

We score every method on the instances it generates. Each dataset–model pair contributes
1000 instances, and a method scores an instance when it has at least two predictions for it.
Two is the smallest count at which semantic entropy is defined, since the measure is
identically zero on a single prediction. The restriction is imposed by the measure rather
than chosen: the three scores read from the original context are defined on a single
prediction and none of them improves under it, so the restriction cannot be what produces
the comparison we report. Unless a table states otherwise, no subselection is applied and
every rewrite a constructor retained for an instance enters that instance’s score.

blocks.en: We evaluate on five extractive QA datasets chosen to span domains and difficulty. SQuAD v1.1 ( Rajpurkar et al., 2016 ) provides standard Wikipedia-based span questions; Quoref ( Dasigi et al., 2019 ) targets questions whose answers require resolving coreference; NewsQA ( Trischler et al., 2017 ) draws on news articles with longer contexts; the Natural Questions partition of MRQA ( Fisch et al., 2019 ; Kwiatkowski et al., 2019 ) supplies naturally occurring information-seeking questions; and AdversarialQA ( Bartolo et al., 2020 ) contributes model-adversarial questions that are hard by construction. All five are extractive, so the gold answer is a span recoverable from the context. We provide dataset statistics in Table 40
blocks.zh: 我们评价了五个采掘质量保证数据集,这些数据集选择了覆盖域和难度。 SQuAD v1.1(Rajpurkar等人,2016年)提供基于维基百科的标准跨度问题;Quoref(Dasigi等人,2019年)针对需要解析共参考的问题;NewsQA(Trischler等人,2017年)借鉴了具有较长背景的新闻文章;MRQA的自然问题分区(Fisch等人,2019年;Kwiatkowski等人,2019年)提供自然发生的信息寻访问题;AdversarialQA(Bartolo等人,2020年)提供模型对抗性问题,因构建难度很大. 所有五个都是采掘的,所以黄金答案是一个从上下文中可以回收的跨度. 我们提供表40中的数据集统计数据。

blocks.en: We draw a fixed sample of 1000 1000 examples per dataset and share it across all constructors. Sampling is random without replacement under the global seed ( 7 7 ), and the same sampled example identifiers are used by every constructor within a dataset, so constructors are never compared on different examples. We filter the questions such that only answerable questions remain as samples in our study. Therefore, we discard the examples with empty context, question, or answer. All of the samples included in the experiments have at least one gold answer.

blocks.en: We map every dataset’s gold answers into one uniform format, an answer specification , before any validation or scoring, such that the downstream checks do not depend on how a dataset store its answers. A question’s answer specification is the set of answer strings that count as correct, with the rule that matching any of them suffices. For instance, a question whose listed gold answers are {”Franklin D. Roosevelt”, ”FDR”, ”Roosevelt Franklin D.’́, ”Roosevelt”} yields an answer specification accepting all four, and a prediction matching any one of them (under the normalization of Appendix D ) answers the question. This uniform representation is what lets answer preservation (Appendix C.4 ) and the failure label (Appendix E ) apply identically across datasets.

blocks.en: Appendix I Guarantees and Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录一 保障和限制

blocks.en: Two properties hold for every rewrite in the archive by construction. First, admission is deterministic and independent of the QA model f θ f_{\theta} : a rewrite is stored only once it clears the gates of Appendix C.4 , none of which query f θ f_{\theta} . A pretrained model (BERTScore) enters only at the later ranking stage, when the search objective score ranks the valid rewrites within a cell. It can change which valid rewrite is kept, never whether an invalid one is admitted (Appendix C.5 ). Second, the rewrite-type axis 𝒯 \mathcal{T} is a verified label, not merely a requested one, for NE, SBS and FP: their realization guard rejects any rewrite that does not exhibit the requested edit. U-ME omits that guard and labels by request alone (Table 36 ).
blocks.zh: 通过构建重写归档的每个文件,有两个属性。 首先,录取是决定性的,并且独立于QA模式f θf_{\theta}: a 重写只在清除附录 C.4 的关卡时才被存储,其中没有查询 f θ f_{\theta}。 预训模型(BERTScore)仅在后期排名阶段进入,此时搜索目标分数在单元格内对有效的重写进行排名. 它可以改变哪些有效的重写被保留,决不改变是否允许无效的(附录C.5 ). 第二,重写型轴 T\ mathcal{T} 是NE, SBS 和 FP 的已验证标签, 而不仅仅是请求的标签: 他们的实现守护拒绝任何不显示请求编辑的重写 。 U-ME仅以请求方式省略了该警卫和标签(表36)。

blocks.en:
Three properties are deliberately not certified, and we do not claim them. First, meaning is not verified: the support-explicitness axis records where the answer’s cues sit, not that meaning is preserved, and its paraphrastic bucket is a residual with no
paraphrase test (Appendix C.2.2 ). Likewise an inserted distractor is checked only to be a genuinely new sentence, not to be answer-irrelevant (Appendix C.4.2 ). Second, the search objecive terms are lightweight surface proxies, they are not learned by a model or human judgments of syntax, fluency, or semantics. They shape ranking only, never admission (Appendix C.5 ). Third, generations are not bit-for-bit reproducible: the editor samples without a fixed per-call seed, so we treat each run’s archive as a fixed artifact and compute all results on it (Appendix C.6 ). Wherever a property is imposed by the prompt rather than checked by a gate, we report it as requested, not verified.

参数测试(附录C.2.2)。 同样,所插入的转移注意力器只被检查为真正新的句子,而不是与答案无关(附录C.4.2)。 其二,搜索objective词汇为轻量级表面代词,它们不是通过模型或人类对语法,流利,或语义的判断来学习的. 他们只塑造排名,从不录取(附录C.5 . 第三,世代不是比特比特的可复制品:编辑器样本没有固定的每个调用种子,所以我们把每个运行的归档作为固定的文物处理,并计算它上的所有结果(附录C.6 ). 无论何时财产是由迅速者强加的,而不是由大门检查的,我们都会按要求报告,而不是核实。
